items.name: android-agent-harness
items.description: Provider-neutral bounded agent runtime for Android/JVM: controlled context (trust/priority/budgets), profile-scoped tools, OpenAI-compatible live mode, governed-evolution eval, and a high-risk-pause device loop.

items.name: local-llm-coding-eval
items.description: An eval harness and report on some of the latest LLMs that can be run locally

items.name: dsh-eval-harness
items.description: DSH 插件评测工具：YAML 用例驱动真实 agent 回归评测 + baseline 对比 PASS/WARN/FAIL 门禁｜Regression eval harness for DeepSeek Harness plugins

items.name: eval-hotel-bot-deepeval-eval-harness
items.description: DeepEval eval harness for a bilingual (RU/KY) hotel WhatsApp bot: DeepSeek LLM-as-judge validated with Cohen's kappa, deterministic safety/grounding gates.

items.name: dsh-agent-eval
items.description: Planned repeatable agent and plugin regression evaluation for DeepSeek Harness

items.name: dsh-eval
items.description: Agent evaluation platform for DeepSeek Harness: benchmark YAML, headless dsh orchestration, trace-based metrics, LLM judge, paired A/B, keyless replay, and cross-harness import.

items.name: DeepSeek-Benchmarking-locally-1.3B-and-7B-models
items.description: Benchmarking DeepSeek 1.3B and 7B models with FP16 and 8bit quantizations locally using HuggingFace and lm-eval-harness with mobile RTX 4090

items.name: llama-mtmd-eval
items.description: Regression + evaluation harness for llama.cpp mtmd OCR (DeepSeek-OCR v1/v2, Unlimited-OCR) vs HF references

items.name: obs-agent
items.description: LLM agent for multi-cloud (Azure/GCP) cost triage — natural-language queries, tool-calling, eval harness (Claude/DeepSeek/Ollama)

items.name: auria-content-workshop
items.description: AI content-generation backend: a real eval + compliance + cost harness around a single LLM call. Provider-portable (Sonnet→DeepSeek). Interview showcase — all data synthetic.

items.name: dsh-browser-bridge
items.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin + browser extension bridge: browser_* agent tools (navigate, click, type, screenshot, eval) over a localhost WebSocket — like Kimi WebBridge / Claude's browser extension.

items.name: dense-transfer
items.description: A prompt protocol and eval harness for token-efficient, accuracy-preserving LLM output. Strip ceremony, keep claims.

items.name: prageval
items.description: A lightweight evaluation harness for community-conditioned pragmatic failures in frontier LLMs. Cross-model eval of pragmatic flattening on Chinese community-coded expressions (GPT/Claude/Qwen/DeepSeek).

items.name: veriva-eval
items.description: Cross-model LLM-as-judge eval harness: validate AI judges with Fleiss' kappa / Krippendorff's alpha, not accuracy. Ships a real 7-model panel (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM) you can replay in ~30s, no API key. MIT.

items.name: five-level-email-personalizer
items.description: White-labeled 5-Level Email Personalizer for Champions Group brands (LakeB2B, SPAN Global Services, Ampliz). Multi-model variations (Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT-4o), eval harness, FastAPI + React + arq.

items.name: vietnamese-secretary-llm
items.description: Vietnamese AI secretary chatbot — serverless vLLM on Modal with hybrid RAG (SQLite + bge-m3), python_exec tool-calling, and an LLM-as-Judge eval harness benchmarking Qwen3.5-9B, DeepSeek-R1-8B & Gemma-4-E4B.

items.name: rag-local
items.description: Hand-rolled local RAG over a Markdown corpus — FastAPI + Qdrant + fastembed (local embeddings), grounded generation via DeepSeek, a React 'Reading Room' UI, and a retrieval eval harness (Recall@k + Precision@1). One-command Docker Compose, built from first principles (no LangChain).

items.name: dsh-plugin-web-access
items.description: 纯本地的 DSH 按需网页访问插件：web_fetch 命令行抓取 + 无头浏览器（open/snapshot/eval/screenshot）双通道，免费、无需 API Key | Local-first web access plugin for DeepSeek Harness

items.name: -writing-research-agent
items.description: Multi-step LLM agent that turns a one-line creative brief into a usable story bible. Planner→Retrieve→Storm→Clear→Research→Check pipeline, 3-source layered RAG, automatic private-canon conflict resolution, robust JSON parsing, and a 6-dimension A/B eval harness. DeepSeek-powered, CLI + Flask/SSE web UI.
